investigation.finding: Dominant and still-worsening slow file across every sampled day this week (per-file summed time 22.9s-81.8s, peaking on the 07-30 sample). Single slowest test: "should skip FINAL and apply hash-based sampling for large matched datasets" (~L457-521), 4.2s-24.2s, the file's one true 120,000-row test.
investigation.rootCause: insertLargeTraceLevelScorePairs (L112-161) inserts 120,000 rows via 12 SEQUENTIAL `for` + `await createScoresCh(...)` batches of 20,000 rows each. createScoresCh (packages/shared/src/server/test-utils/clickhouse-helpers.ts) is a single stateless clickhouseClient().insert() call per invocation with no shared/mutable state; per-row values are independent (Math.random()-based, no order-dependent assertions) and the file has zero beforeEach/afterEach hooks (grep-confirmed). Existing precedent for concurrent use of these Ch helpers: scores-api-v2.servertest.ts:104.
investigation.candidateFix: Parallelize the batch loop with Promise.all instead of sequential awaits; same pattern applies to the analogous insertLargeIdenticalTraceLevelScores helper (L163-197), used with smaller row counts today.
